S.FORM: alan khaw na 'tayal aring sraral mutuw pmhyun Tayal ka mutuw naha' galan khaw hya' ga, mluw squ qqyanux naha' mmuhi' sa ruma' tayal sa ggalan naha' ttngasal han, babaw nya' mwah qu Gipun lga, sgsugun na Gipun maha qiri' mmuhi' sa labing ru blhuy, ru galun na Gipun sbaziy naha' tay Gipun maha ruw, aring kya qu lawkah muhi' kya kwara' qu qalang na Tayal qani. suruw na Gipun lga, yaqu nuka' na kgiy squ bblhuy qu spyang bzirun na Plmukan galan khaw na Tayal hya' ha, yalaw gi wayal t'rgun tmutu' na Plmukan kwara' qqhuniq rgyax tayal lru, ki'a naha' skngungu' ppsluhiy kwara' rhzyal rgrgyax lru, sgin na aki' ta' pkmtasiq kwara' rhzyal Taywan maha lru, aring 45 kawas thayluw lqu sglaing naha' mmuhi' qayparung Gipun la, nanu' ktan kya na Tayal lruw, yasa siy ppmuhi' qayparung kwara' qu Tayal kya la. kwara' qani hya' ga kahul sa bbzirun na Plmukan qu spmuhi' naha' qani hya'. tayhuk 60 kawas thayluw lga, wal si 'nxal yaqih kwara' qu bbziran khkhaw tayal ka rruma' ru qayparung ru kwara' ka bblhuy ru nuka' uzi lruw, minusa' sayqabu' hugal kwara' qu mmrkyas tayal kruma', ga musa' muhi' tqinuw rgyax kruma' qu tayal hya' ha, ga ini' tayhuk mawpuw kawas lga, mngaygyut mwah mmuhi' baybway qhuniq ka nasi', qzimux, ru bnubuw qani lga, ini' qbsyaq uzi, ruw iyugun naha' sa qapu' Gipun la, babaw niya' lga, pzyux iyal qu muhi' sa baybway lru, mkura' sa muhi' rramat qu maki' tay rgyax la, ruw nanu' ya'qani qu nyuw naha' lhingan mlahang na' misuw qani la.
S.PHON: alan kħaw na ʔtajal ariŋ [s|ɕ]raral mutuw pmħjun tajal ka mutuw naħaʔ ɣalan kħaw ħjaʔ ɣa mluw [s|ɕ]qu qqjanux naħaʔ mmuħiʔ [s|ɕ]a rumaʔ tajal [s|ɕ]a ɣɣalan naħaʔ ttŋa[s|ɕ]al ħan βaβaw njaʔ mwaħ qu ɣipun lɣa [s|ɕ]ɣ[s|ɕ]uɣun na ɣipun maħa qiriʔ mmuħiʔ [s|ɕ]a laβiŋ ru βlħuj ru ɣalun na ɣipun [s|ɕ]βazij naħaʔ taj ɣipun maħa ruw ariŋ kja qu lawkaħ muħiʔ kja kwaraʔ qu qalaŋ na tajal qani [s|ɕ]uruw na ɣipun lɣa jaqu nukaʔ na kɣij [s|ɕ]qu ββlħuj qu [s|ɕ]pjaŋ βzirun na plmukan ɣalan kħaw na tajal ħjaʔ ħa jalaw ɣi wajal tʔrɣun tmutuʔ na plmukan kwaraʔ qqħuniq rɣjax tajal lru kiʔa naħaʔ [s|ɕ]kŋuŋuʔ pp[s|ɕ]luħij kwaraʔ rħzjal rɣrɣjax lru [s|ɕ]ɣin na akiʔ taʔ pkmta[s|ɕ]iq kwaraʔ rħzjal tajwan maħa lru ariŋ ** kawa[s|ɕ] tħajluw lqu [s|ɕ]ɣlaiŋ naħaʔ mmuħiʔ qajparuŋ ɣipun la nanuʔ ktan kja na tajal lruw ja[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]ij ppmuħiʔ qajparuŋ kwaraʔ qu tajal kja la kwaraʔ qani ħjaʔ ɣa kaħul [s|ɕ]a ββzirun na plmukan qu [s|ɕ]pmuħiʔ naħaʔ qani ħjaʔ tajħuk ** kawa[s|ɕ] tħajluw lɣa wal [s|ɕ]i ʔnxal jaqiħ kwaraʔ qu ββziran kħkħaw tajal ka rrumaʔ ru qajparuŋ ru kwaraʔ ka ββlħuj ru nukaʔ uzi lruw minu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]ajqaβuʔ ħuɣal kwaraʔ qu mmrkja[s|ɕ] tajal krumaʔ ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ muħiʔ tqinuw rɣjax krumaʔ qu tajal ħjaʔ ħa ɣa iniʔ tajħuk mawpuw kawa[s|ɕ] lɣa mŋajɣjut mwaħ mmuħiʔ βajβwaj qħuniq ka na[s|ɕ]iʔ qzimux ru βnuβuw qani lɣa iniʔ qβ[s|ɕ]jaq uzi ruw ijuɣun naħaʔ [s|ɕ]a qapuʔ ɣipun la βaβaw nijaʔ lɣa pzjux ijal qu muħiʔ [s|ɕ]a βajβwaj lru mkuraʔ [s|ɕ]a muħiʔ rramat qu makiʔ taj rɣjax la ruw nanuʔ jaʔqani qu njuw naħaʔ lħiŋan mlaħaŋ naʔ mi[s|ɕ]uw qani la
